title: What's new in BrickVerse Creator
subtitle: A more connected editor with stronger publishing, scripting, and collaboration workflows.

sections.title: A smarter code editor
sections.body: Writing Luau now feels much closer to a modern IDE, with Creator-aware language tooling.
items: Up-to-date world, game, script, class, property, and child suggestions
Hover documentation, inline diagnostics, and improved error visibility
StyLua-powered document and selection formatting
Syntax highlighting for Luau, JSON, JSONC, YAML, TOML, C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, and more
Open scripts in an external editor such as VS Code or Zed

sections.title: Publishing and Asset Manager
sections.body: Assets are easier to publish, preview, discover, update, and reuse across projects.
items: New Asset Manager dock for owned and universe assets
Prefab publishing with editable metadata and an interactive 3D preview camera
Toolbox and Asset Manager prefab insertion, including safe script-import warnings
Improved mesh, texture, sound, animation, model, and prefab upload flows
Website asset links can open and insert content directly in Creator

sections.title: Terrain and animation workflows
sections.body: Build richer environments and character animation without leaving Creator.
items: Custom TerrainMaterial instances with color, surface, Albedo, and PBR controls
Flatten, smooth, paint, heightmap import, and procedural terrain generation tools
Terrain persistence, publishing, replication, rendering, and collision improvements
Character-rig animation editor with 3D preview, keyframes, gizmos, IK, camera controls, and wireframe view
FBX and GLTF animation import plus .bvanim publishing

sections.title: Play testing and collaboration
sections.body: Debugging and Team Create now stay closer to the normal editing experience.
items: Docked client and server runtime Explorer, Properties, Console, and Luau execution tools
Improved play-test viewport placement, resizing, cleanup, and runtime inspection
Team Create presence, camera avatars, reconnection, terrain, instance, and property replication improvements
Session, Collaborate, connection, and Team Create status controls in the toolbar
Idle client handling and improved local network recovery

sections.title: Creator quality-of-life
sections.body: The home screen and common editing actions received a broad usability pass.
items: Redesigned full-screen Creator home with world cards, loading feedback, and automatic project folders
Quick access to Forge AI, Terrain, Animator, Toolbox, Asset Manager, and Input Manager
Beta Features enrollment and expanded Creator settings
Interactive onboarding tutorial, camera-speed indicator, output filters, trace links, and improved scrollback
What's New and update notifications can be disabled from Creator settings
